messages:
Alex Chen: quick sync — opened PR with a proposed embeddings contract for mixed inputs, truncation, batch limits, and response shape. TL;DR: preserve input positions, truncate to UTF-8 codepoint boundary, max_items=1024, max_total_chars=100000, empty string -> zero-vector by default, null -> null in response + warning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/452

Priya Patel: quick q — when you say truncate at codepoint boundary, do you mean before tokenization? we need deterministic behavior across tokenizers.

Alex Chen: yes — truncate on raw UTF-8 bytes at the nearest codepoint boundary before any tokenization or normalization. that keeps byte-budget enforcement model-agnostic. I'll update the spec doc with an explicit example.

Sam P: two things: 1) if an item is over the limit do we truncate or reject the whole batch? 2) what do we return for empty string vs completely missing (null)? prefer not to drop items silently.

Alex Chen: plan is to TRUNCATE, not reject, and surface events in a warnings array. behavior summary: - truncate long items (record warning with original_length + final_length) - if allow_nulls=true then null inputs map to null in embeddings array + warning; if allow_nulls=false then reject (400) - empty string maps to zero-vector by default (explicit signal for "no content"). we can add a flag preserve_empty_as_embedding to override to model-derived embedding.

Jordan Lee: shape & schema check — propose response shape: { "embeddings": [<vector|null>, ...], "warnings": [{"index":<i>,"code":"truncated"|"null_input","original_length":<n>}], "model": "redwood-embed-v2", "dim": 1536 } . non-null entries must be arrays of floats length == dim.

Alex Chen: exact example I'm adding to the spec (pasted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "input": ["hello", "", null, "<very long text>"], "allow_nulls": true }

200 OK
{
  "embeddings": [[0.121, -0.034, ...], [0.0, 0.0, ...], null, [0.230, -0.012, ...]],
  "warnings": [{"index":2,"code":"null_input"},{"index":3,"code":"truncated","original_length":20000}],
  "model":"redwood-embed-v2",
  "dim":"1536"
}
```

Priya Patel: small nit — in the response example dim should be a number not a string. also please spell out whether the zero-vector is literally all zeros or a deterministic sentinel (we should be explicit).

Alex Chen: good catch — will make dim an integer. zero-vector = literal zeros (float zeros) by default. will add the preserve_empty_as_embedding toggle to the API for teams that want the model embedding for "" instead.

Sam P: will add a unit/integration test to the SDK that: - hits the endpoint with mixed input types - asserts embeddings.length == input.length - asserts non-null entries have length == dim - asserts warnings contain correct indices for truncated/null - checks empty string behavior toggled by preserve_empty_as_embedding

DeployBot: snapshot created for branch embed-spec (build #7182). CI: ✅ all tests passed.

Jordan Lee: LGTM from infra side, but @design for API docs wording and @devex for SDK ergonomics.

Alex Chen: thanks — if no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning and follow up with a release note for SDK owners. @Sam P please add SDK PR link to the description before merge.
